title: Harvest and Choir
author: Zephyrine Eastwick
blurb: Ada Whitlock, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
